context: Editability gate placement in rollout Phase C (measured-gates.md § Gate 6), hands-off, offline. Task and setup in task.md; each item is judged pass/fail and weighted by max_score.

checklist.name: probe_ingested_via_gate_flag
checklist.description: Both probe artifacts are ingested with update-coverage.mjs --gate editability <json> (or the agent re-runs ew-editability-probe.mjs --json over the authored files and ingests that output). pages.json is never hand-edited; the gate block delivery.gates.editability on home carries authored 7, editable 5, dead 2, origin harness copied from the artifact.

checklist.name: dead_page_failed_never_deployed
checklist.description: home ends failed with an error naming the editability gate, the count and the block (dead 2 in cards); it is never flipped deployed, never PUT/previewed, never listed in a publish set. A run that pushes home or marks it deployed before the fix fails this item.

checklist.name: block_row_ewgate
checklist.description: coverage/blocks.json: the coverage-tiles row (edsBlockName cards) carries delivery.ewGate: fail (and ew{dead: 2}); hero-statement carries ewGate: pass. Written by the ingest, not by hand.

checklist.name: fix_by_moving_never_weakening
checklist.description: No --no-ew, no --exempt cards / CLI exemption, no @ew-exempt tag added to cards.js to pass the page. If the agent fixes the block, cards.js moves the authored <h3> into the wrapper (node-slotting) and the probe + ingest are re-run; otherwise the page stays failed with the reason and the rollout continues on business. Any exemption or gate skip fails this item.

checklist.name: editability_line_computed
checklist.description: The checkpoint / Phase H block prints the Editability line (editable/authored · dead · exempt · unmeasured) with numbers equal to rollout.json lastRun.gates.editability after the last ingest — never blank, never typed from memory.

checklist.name: blocked_no_publish_inputs_intact
checklist.description: Nothing is published or claimed published; the run ends blocked (no DA target) with the exact next command and no question; stardust/migrated/** and stardust/replica/** are byte-identical; stardust/rollout/ew/*.json unchanged unless a legitimate re-probe after a code fix rewrote them.
